title: Monster dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='22' ry='3.5' fill='#43328c'/>

  <path d='M32 60 Q26 74 34 84 Q42 90 50 88 Q58 90 66 84 Q74 74 68 60 Q62 50 50 50 Q38 50 32 60 Z' fill='#3ecf6e'/>

  <circle cx='44' cy='72' r='3' fill='#9bf7b6'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='77' r='2.5' fill='#9bf7b6'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='67' r='2' fill='#9bf7b6'/>

  <path d='M33 58 Q22 50 18 38' stroke='#3ecf6e' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <path d='M67 58 Q80 56 86 46' stroke='#3ecf6e' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <circle cx='74' cy='86' r='5' fill='#7cf7a4'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='20' fill='#3ecf6e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='16' fill='#63e88f'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M36 19 Q32 8 40 6 Q42 14 42 20 Z' fill='#ff7ad9'/>
  <path d='M64 19 Q68 8 60 6 Q58 14 58 20 Z' fill='#ff7ad9'/>

  <ellipse cx='43' cy='32' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#f6fff8'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='32' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#f6fff8'/>

  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='2.6' fill='#22104a'/>

  <circle cx='59' cy='31' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <path d='M42 40 Q50 50 58 40 Q50 46 42 40 Z' fill='#22104a'/>
  <path d='M44 41 Q50 47 56 41 Q50 44 44 41 Z' fill='#ff5f7e'/>

  <rect x='46' y='41' width='3' height='3' rx='0.8' fill='#f6fff8'/>
  <rect x='52' y='41' width='3' height='3' rx='0.8' fill='#f6fff8'/>
  <!-- musical notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd45e'>
    <path d='M20 24 q0 -4 4 -4 v10 q-1 -2 -4 -1 z'/>
    <path d='M80 22 q0 -4 4 -4 v10 q-1 -2 -4 -1 z'/>
